en-US.description: Free Windows Client for Amazon S3 and Amazon CloudFront
en-US.longDescription: CS Browser is a freeware Windows client for Amazon S3 and Amazon CloudFront. Amazon S3 provides a simple web services interface that can be used to store and retrieve any amount of data, at any time, from anywhere on the web. Amazon CloudFront is a content delivery network (CDN). It can be used to deliver your files using a global network of edge locations.
en-US.name: CS Browser
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Added Upload with Filters and Download with Filters
- Expanded Display Filter with path, time, storage class, and size rules
- Added paged Text and Hex previews, plus image details and copy actions
- Added account selection for individual Folder Sync jobs
- Faster Folder Sync analysis and batched deletions
- Added CLI file filters for list and download, with download dry run
- Reduced task queue memory use and improved Cancel All responsiveness
- Fixed retries after temporary network errors in UI and CLI tasks
- Other internal improvements and bug fixes

zh-CN.description: 适用于 Amazon S3 和 Amazon CloudFront 的免费 Windows 客户端
zh-CN.longDescription: CS Browser 是一款适用于 Amazon S3 和 Amazon CloudFront 的免费 Windows 客户端。Amazon S3 提供简易的 Web 服务接口，可用于随时随地在互联网上存储和检索任意量级的数据。Amazon CloudFront 是内容分发网络（CDN），能通过全球边缘站点网络高效分发您的文件。
